question.text: A mutual fund AMC fails to comply with SEBI activity restriction regulations for 15 consecutive days. Under Section 15E, what is the maximum penalty exposure based on the per-day extension for the 15-day failure (ignoring the overall Rs. 1 crore cap)?

answer.text: Rs. 15 lakh (Rs. 1 lakh per day for 15 days)
Rs. 1 lakh (flat penalty regardless of duration)

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 15E prescribes a penalty of not less than Rs. 1 lakh, which may extend to Rs. 1 lakh for each day during which the failure continues, subject to a maximum of Rs. 1 crore. For 15 days, the per-day extension can reach 15 × Rs. 1 lakh = Rs. 15 lakh, well within the Rs. 1 crore cap. The Trap: Rs. 1 lakh is the statutory minimum, not the per-day amount. The Rs. 1 lakh per day figure is the extension rate; Rs. 1 crore is the overall ceiling, not a from-day-one penalty. Note: The Rs. 1 crore cap is reached only when the per-day extension accumulates over time; for a 15-day failure, the cap is not binding.
